scenarios.title: Network namespace real GSO skb
scenarios.instructions: Create network namespaces and a veth pair, prove a real GSO skb reaches NFQUEUE, and retain commands plus packet capture.

scenarios.title: ClientHello 1988 B
scenarios.instructions: Send the same logical ClientHello at 1988 B through MSS and GSO layouts and compare classification/action identity.

scenarios.title: ClientHello 4 KiB
scenarios.instructions: Send the same logical ClientHello at 4 KiB through MSS and GSO layouts and compare classification/action identity.

scenarios.title: ClientHello 16 KiB
scenarios.instructions: Send the same logical ClientHello at 16 KiB through MSS and GSO layouts and compare classification/action identity.

scenarios.title: ClientHello 32 KiB
scenarios.instructions: Send the same logical ClientHello at 32 KiB through MSS and GSO layouts and compare classification/action identity.

scenarios.title: NFQA_CAP_LEN and checksum metadata
scenarios.instructions: Exercise truncated packet copies and NFQA_SKB_CSUMNOTREADY; prove fail-open or completed bounded reassembly without packet-local false classification.

scenarios.title: Unchanged NF_ACCEPT
scenarios.instructions: Verify an accept-only GSO packet leaves NFQUEUE unchanged with identical length/hash and no secondary action.

scenarios.title: Mutation requiring normalization
scenarios.instructions: Exercise a normal-packet ActionPlan through the certified direct-queue or NF_REPEAT mechanism and prove consume-once token lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Hold timeout and shutdown cleanup
scenarios.instructions: Force hold timeout and daemon shutdown while normalization state exists; packets must release unchanged and all transient state must clear.

scenarios.title: Queue listener crash
scenarios.instructions: Crash the classifier or normalizer listener under active traffic and prove queue-bypass/fail-open, reconciliation and no leak.

scenarios.title: IPv4 with iptables
scenarios.instructions: Run classify and normalized-action cases on IPv4 using B4-owned iptables rules.

scenarios.title: IPv6 with nftables
scenarios.instructions: Run classify and normalized-action cases on IPv6 using B4-owned nftables rules.

scenarios.title: Production/candidate/discovery isolation
scenarios.instructions: Run simultaneous production, candidate and Discovery traffic; prove queue, token, action and evidence state never cross scopes.

scenarios.title: PPE visibility
scenarios.instructions: Verify PPE deoffload and incoming progress visibility are complete enough for classify/action gates; incomplete windows must fail open.

scenarios.title: Keenetic CPU, RAM and queue drops
scenarios.instructions: Run sustained target load and retain bounded CPU/RAM/queue-drop evidence.

scenarios.title: Chrome cold-run A/B
scenarios.instructions: Run cold Chrome profiles with DNS/conntrack/B4 state reset and compare baseline versus hardening completion milestones.

scenarios.title: Official YouTube and ReVanced
scenarios.instructions: Exercise official YouTube and ReVanced cold starts, first API/UI/video flows and sustained playback.

scenarios.title: Instagram, Facebook and Cloudflare controls
scenarios.instructions: Run negative-control services and prove no unrelated action, route, RST suppression or reconnect regression.

scenarios.title: Discovery reproducibility A/B
scenarios.instructions: Repeat baseline/candidate Discovery probes with identical generation and environment; suppression cannot be standalone success proof.

scenarios.title: Legitimate closed-port RST before SYN-ACK
scenarios.instructions: Connect to a known closed port and prove the legitimate pre-SYN-ACK RST is passed.

scenarios.title: Legitimate server RST after SYN-ACK
scenarios.instructions: Establish SYN/SYN-ACK without app payload and trigger a legitimate server reset; it must pass.

scenarios.title: Legitimate RST after server payload progress
scenarios.instructions: Trigger reset after inbound application payload; server progress must force pass and flow cleanup.

scenarios.title: Exact-flow forged pre-response RST
scenarios.instructions: Inject an exact-flow pre-response RST satisfying the conservative strong+corroborating matrix and prove bounded suppression.

scenarios.title: Multi-RST burst
scenarios.instructions: Inject a bounded burst and prove burst evidence, suppression budget and non-sliding window behavior.

scenarios.title: Matching and mismatching TTL
scenarios.instructions: Compare RSTs matching the robust baseline and safely mismatching it; TTL alone must not suppress.

scenarios.title: Stable and route-change TTL baseline
scenarios.instructions: Build a stable baseline, change the route and prove stale/route-change quality disables active suppression.

scenarios.title: ECMP and anycast path variation
scenarios.instructions: Exercise legitimate ECMP/anycast variation and prove the robust spread does not systematically drop valid resets.

scenarios.title: Impossible and valid SEQ/ACK
scenarios.instructions: Test valid in-window resets and cryptographically impossible/out-of-window resets on the same FSM model.

scenarios.title: TCP option mismatch
scenarios.instructions: Change the reset packet TCP option fingerprint and prove it is corroborating only, never standalone suppression proof.

scenarios.title: RST without ACK
scenarios.instructions: Exercise a reset without ACK in legitimate and forged contexts and prove FSM-aware handling.

scenarios.title: IPv4 TTL and IPv6 hop-limit
scenarios.instructions: Validate baseline quality and decision parity for IPv4 TTL and IPv6 hop-limit.

scenarios.title: Incomplete PPE visibility
scenarios.instructions: Create an incomplete PPE visibility window; active suppression must be impossible and the reset must fail open.

scenarios.title: Unknown flow
scenarios.instructions: Send a reset with no exact-flow FSM entry; it must fail open without creating suppression state.

scenarios.title: Budget exhaustion
scenarios.instructions: Exhaust the per-flow/global suppression budget; subsequent resets must fail open and the window must not slide.

scenarios.title: Config generation change
scenarios.instructions: Change the active config generation with tracked flows; old evidence and budgets must not authorize new-generation suppression.

scenarios.title: Rollback on reconnect regression
scenarios.instructions: Cause reconnect/no-progress regression inside one exact scope and prove automatic rollback to observe while last-good remains intact.

scenarios.title: Cloudflare reconnect/control scenarios
scenarios.instructions: Exercise Cloudflare reconnect and control flows; legitimate resets and reconnects must not regress.

scenarios.title: GSO classify plus passive RST observe
scenarios.instructions: Run GSO classification while passive RST remains observe-only; decisions must not alter packets.

scenarios.title: GSO normalize with RST during held first flight
scenarios.instructions: Inject RST while first-flight packets are held for normalization; terminal verdict and transient cleanup must remain correct.

scenarios.title: GSO token timeout plus RST
scenarios.instructions: Expire the GSO token before secondary delivery and inject RST; both paths must fail open and clear state.

scenarios.title: Candidate queue and RST suppression isolation
scenarios.instructions: Run candidate traffic with suppression evidence and prove production mode, budgets and audit state remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: PPE deoffload window plus GSO
scenarios.instructions: Exercise the transition from PPE deoffload to complete GSO visibility; unsafe actions must stay suppressed during the window.

scenarios.title: Hot topology rollback with active flows
scenarios.instructions: Fail a hot topology transition while flows are active; old rules/workers/generation must remain authoritative.

scenarios.title: Router restart with stale rules/tokens/marks
scenarios.instructions: Restart with deliberately present transient topology state and prove startup reconciliation removes only B4-owned stale state.

scenarios.title: Sustained load and memory pressure
scenarios.instructions: Run sustained Android/control traffic under memory/queue pressure and prove bounded fail-open degradation and resource use.
